errorCodes.meaning: No group the caller may manage has this identifier.
The community's VTA did not answer. The group still exists; the community retries the withdrawal, and the request may be sent again.

schema.description: A group manager deletes a group: its bindings are withdrawn first, its members' credential renewal stops and its authorization credential is revoked, and only then is the group removed. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Why, recorded with the change and shown to anyone who must approve it.
